description: Current airport weather from NOAA Aviation Weather Center: latest METAR (observed temperature, dewpoint, wind, visibility, altimeter, flight category) and the TAF forecast text for a 4-letter ICAO airport code. Raw text is included alongside the parsed fields. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
